people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
translations.bsb: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
translations.kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
translations.asv: There is little Benjamin their ruler, The princes of Judah and their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
